def main():
    s = input().strip()
    ans = [s[0]]
    i = 1
    n = len(s)
    at_used = False

    while i < n:
        if n - i >= 3 and s[i:i+3] == "dot":
            ans.append('.')
            i += 3
        elif s[i] == 'a' and n - i >= 2 and s[i+1] == 't' and not at_used:
            ans.append('@')
            at_used = True
            i += 2
        else:
            ans.append(s[i])
            i += 1

    print(''.join(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
